text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Midway through summer camp. In order to 
further improve her skills, she devoted 
herself to training. However—
choice_data_list: (My body feels so heavy and sluggish...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a fever, but I've lost my 
appetite and feel exhausted from morning 
to night. As I'm wondering what's wrong—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you feeling a bit worn down 
by the summer heat~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Lately she hasn't been eating much, and 
she looks really exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Are you gonna be okay~? It's hot out, so 
not being able to eat has me worried~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll whip up a meal that's easy to 
eat and packed with nutrition~!
choice_data_list: Even so, going that far is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's my precious Trainer's body, after 
all! Leave it to me♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono was going to make 
lunch for us.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All done~♪ Thanks for waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here is Chef Buono's buonissimo recipe☆ 
"Refreshing☆ Somen Noodles"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I tossed some summer veggies, herbs, 
noodle soup base, and canned mackerel into 
easy-to-slurp somen~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here's another buonissimo recipe from Chef 
Bono! "Heart-Pounding ☆ Summer 
Yakibitashi"~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I crisped up some pork, quickly seared 
some summer veggies, and chilled them in 
the fridge in a broth of soy sauce, mirin, 
and bonito dashi~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Pork is especially great for preventing 
summer fatigue, so I really, really hope 
you'll eat plenty of it~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome~. Come on, let's hurry up 
and eat~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An appetite that wasn't supposed to be 
there was stirred, and I took one bite, 
then two.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The combination of the noodle broth and 
the savory canned mackerel is exquisite, 
and the chilled vegetables and condiments 
add a great touch—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The yakibitashi offered a gentle flavor, 
where biting into the savory meat and 
vegetables released a refreshing, 
soaked-in broth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad~ Eat plenty and get 
well soon, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She cooked for me from time to time after 
that... and before I knew it, I had 
completely regained my energy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, doing what she wants on her own 
without hesitation is just how Hishi 
Akebono is."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to think of what would make her 
happy, I ultimately decided to ask her 
directly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Pay me back~? Nah, don't worry about 
it at all~.
choice_data_list: Because you're always helping me out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, really? I don't think that's true, 
but... well then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...I'd really love to go to the fireworks 
festival with you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh, whoa. Yay~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we ended up going to the fireworks 
festival, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hyaa~, there's so many people~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna get squished before the 
fireworks even go off~. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono still seems to be having 
fun, but it certainly feels like it's a 
bit too crowded.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should look for another spot. 
Though it looks like the fireworks are 
about to start soon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm sure once the fireworks go off, 
you won't even notice anymore~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as we waited leisurely right 
there, the fireworks began to shoot up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle~~*...... *BOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wah! So pretty! And huge~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn by the cheers, I crane my neck, but 
the person in front of me is tall, and the 
crowd makes it hard to see.
choice_data_list:
(Well, as long as Akebono is happy, that's 
fine...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And just as I was about to give up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My body was hoisted up with incredible 
force!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, piggyback ride~. How is it? Can you 
see well~?
choice_data_list: I-I can see it, I can see it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay, so pretty~! It's so big and 
beautiful~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, it's summer after all. You know, 
I really wanted to watch the fireworks 
with you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono sounded so happy saying 
that, I couldn't bring myself to ask her 
to put me down right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, during the summer training 
camp, I made a wonderful memory with Hishi 
Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A different spot? I see, it is a bit 
cramped here~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's head somewhere where we can relax a 
bit more~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we quickly moved to the beach 
where we usually do our training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's pitch black~! Though you're 
right, we should get a great view from the 
sea♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go over that way and sit down to 
watch~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Eek!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I couldn't see my footing and took 
a spill. I'm totally fine, don't worry~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I couldn't just let her keep 
falling. Without thinking, I reached out 
my hand.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heh.
choice_data_list: It's dangerous if you fall again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Because I'm so tall, I'm usually 
the one people rely on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Something about this feels kinda ticklish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, we moved to a spot where we 
could sit and watch the fireworks, 
spending an unforgettable time together."
